title: Add hourly unit economics aggregation job + warehouse schema/materialized views
author: Mei Lin
description: Context: This PR implements the v1 hourly aggregation job for the internal Unit Economics dashboard. It introduces warehouse schema migrations, a scheduled aggregator (hourly) that joins token metering with cost inputs (GPU rate card + allocation factors), and initial materialized views to power cost/$ per 1M output tokens drilldowns by model, region, and customer tier. This is the first production path for the canonical metric (blended $/1M output tokens) and is intended to be finance-aligned while still allowing iteration via versioned logic. Scope: (1) New warehouse tables for hourly aggregates and reconciliation-friendly rollups, (2) A job that runs hourly with late-arrival handling and idempotent upserts, (3) Materialized views for dashboard queries (time series + top-N breakdowns), (4) Data validation checks to fail fast on missing dimensions and prevent silent drops. Non-goals: Streaming output token parity is handled in a separate PR; this assumes output_tokens is present and accurate in metering. Implementation details: The aggregator reads from `metering.request_tokens_hourly` (or equivalent staged fact) and joins against `finance.gpu_rate_card_hourly` via normalized region + provider + capacity_type. We allocate shared/idle components using the current v1 allocation factors table (owned by Finance), then compute blended cost per output token. All cost computations are stored in USD with 6 decimals; dashboard views scale to $/1M output tokens. Key tables: `analytics.unit_econ_hourly_fact_v1` (grain: hour x model_id x model_version x quant_profile x region_norm x customer_tier), `analytics.unit_econ_hourly_rollup_v1` (grain: hour x region_norm x customer_tier; used for reconciliation), `analytics.unit_econ_job_runs` (job run audit / late data tracking). Key MVs: `analytics.mv_unit_econ_ts_by_model_region_tier_v1` (time series), `analytics.mv_unit_econ_topn_models_7d_v1`, `analytics.mv_unit_econ_topn_regions_7d_v1`, `analytics.mv_unit_econ_topn_tiers_7d_v1`. Idempotency / late data: We reprocess a sliding window (default 36h) each run to incorporate late-arriving metering, then upsert by primary key (hour + dims + version). We also persist `processed_through_hour` and row counts per run for oncall visibility. Performance: Hourly fact table is partitioned by day(hour_ts) and clustered by (region_norm, model_id, customer_tier). MVs use pre-aggregated measures to keep dashboard query latency <2s for common groupings. Illustrative snippet (aggregation core): `blended_cost_usd = (gpu_compute_cost_usd + gpu_idle_alloc_usd + shared_overhead_alloc_usd)` and `blended_usd_per_1m_output_tokens = (blended_cost_usd / nullif(output_tokens,0)) * 1e6`. Validation: The job asserts non-null for required dims (model_id, region_norm, customer_tier) and records a `dropped_rows_reason` metric when input facts are excluded (e.g., unknown region mapping). Follow-ups: (a) streaming output token parity (ENG-8421), (b) region normalization table productionized (ENG-8424), (c) quantization_profile tagging (ENG-8425). Test plan: `bin/unit_econ_agg --dry-run --start 2025-01-28T00:00Z --end 2025-01-28T06:00Z` against staging; compare rollup totals to billing exports for the same window (within tolerance).
commits: warehouse: add unit economics v1 schema + migrations
jobs: implement hourly unit economics aggregation (sliding window + upsert)
warehouse: add materialized views for time series + top-N breakdowns
tests: add aggregation golden tests + rate card join coverage
ops: add job run auditing + basic validation counters
conversation: Logan Wright (review): Can we confirm the grain includes quant_profile and model_version, even if v1 UI doesn’t expose them yet? If not, we’ll regret it for regressions. Also, what’s the strategy for late metering arrivals (we’ve seen >12h delays during incidents). Mei Lin (author): Yes—fact table grain includes both `model_version` and `quantization_profile` (nullable until ENG-8425 lands), UI can ignore for now. For late arrivals: I set the sliding reprocess window to 36h by default and made it configurable. We upsert into the partitioned fact table keyed by (hour_ts, model_id, model_version, quant_profile, region_norm, customer_tier). Nadia Rahman (review): The job currently filters out rows with missing output_tokens; can we surface that in metrics (otherwise we’ll hide the streaming undercount issue). Also, please ensure we don’t accidentally include input tokens in the denominator. Mei Lin (author): Added counters: `unit_econ_agg.dropped_rows_missing_output_tokens` and `unit_econ_agg.dropped_rows_missing_dims`. Denominator is explicitly `output_tokens` only (see compute_hourly_fact.sql). Caleb Johnson (review): A couple of concerns: 1) null region mapping currently becomes 'unknown' and is included—Finance may not want that in blended KPI. 2) We should add a run audit row even on failure so oncall can see the gap. Mei Lin (author): Addressed (1) by excluding unknown from KPI MVs (still stored in fact for debugging) and adding `unknown_region_tokens` to rollup so reconciliation can explain deltas; (2) job now writes a `job_runs` row at start and updates with status=failed + error summary on exception. Cole Summers (review): Rate card join: I think capacity_type mismatch (reserved vs on-demand) will bite us. Can we default to blended rate by region if capacity_type is null, but also track how often we fall back? Mei Lin (author): Implemented `rate_card_fallback_used` boolean + counter. Join order: exact (region, provider, capacity_type) -> fallback (region, provider, 'blended') -> fallback (region, 'any', 'blended') for staging only (prod will require provider). Added a hard failure if we can’t find a rate for a prod region/provider. Logan Wright (review): Looks good; last request: add a note to docs about versioning (v1) and how we’ll roll v2 without breaking dashboards. Mei Lin (author): Added doc section: schema has `_v1` suffix; future versions write parallel tables/views, with a `analytics.unit_econ_active_version` pointer used by API layer. Logan approved. Nadia approved after re-run. Caleb approved with minor nits. Cole approved.
release_notes: Internal-only: adds hourly unit economics aggregation job and warehouse views to support Unit Economics dashboard queries; no external API changes.
